worldwide.immediate_danger_instruction: If you or someone else may be in immediate danger, contact local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department now. If there is no immediate danger but urgent support is needed, contact a local crisis line, health worker, or trusted person.

resources.name: Find A Helpline
resources.action: Visit https://findahelpline.com/ and select your country to find a verified local emotional-support or crisis service.

CA.immediate_danger_instruction: If you or someone else may be in immediate danger in Canada, call 9-1-1 or go to the nearest emergency department now.

resources.name: Canadian emergency services
resources.action: Call 9-1-1 if you or someone else is in immediate danger in Canada.

resources.name: Canada 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline
resources.action: Call or text 9-8-8 for 24/7 suicide-crisis support in Canada.

US.immediate_danger_instruction: If you or someone else may be in immediate danger in the United States, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department now.

resources.name: United States emergency services
resources.action: Call 911 if you or someone else is in immediate danger in the United States.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.action: Call or text 988 for 24/7 crisis support in the United States, or use chat at https://988lifeline.org/.
